Maximum evidence 2090 against a threshold of 370. #> ✖ Alarm at t = 11 (evidence 2090); estimated change at t = 8. #>  #> ── Assumptions ── #>  #> • Pre-change trials have conditional success probability at most 0.04698; other #> dependence within a subgroup is allowed. #> • The centre was estimated from 15 Phase I observations and is treated as #> known. #> • Observations arrive in time order and none was dropped or imputed. #> • Under these assumptions the expected time to a false alarm is at least 370, #> and the probability of a false alarm by any time t is at most t/370. #> edetect 0.1.0, R version 4.6.1 (2026-06-24)

code: set.seed(1) sizes <- sample(2:4, 20, replace = TRUE) sizes <- sizes[cumsum(sizes) <= 50] sample_id <- rep(seq_along(sizes), sizes) samples <- data.frame(n = sizes,                       x = as.integer(tapply(defects[seq_along(sample_id)], sample_id, sum))) head(samples, 4) #>   n  x #> 1 2  9 #> 2 4 26 #> 3 2 10 #> 4 3 13  u_chart <- edetect_u(samples$x, n = samples$n, center = 6, arl = 370, direction = "both") edetect_alarm(u_chart) #> # A tibble: 1 × 6 #>   alarm alarm_time evidence threshold change_estimate n_observed #>   <lgl>      <int>    <dbl>     <dbl>           <int>      <int> #> 1 FALSE         NA     5.08       370              13         17 autoplot(u_chart)

title: Get started with edetect
text: Tablet weights recorded subgroups five, target 250 mg process standard deviation 1.5 mg. shift 1.5 mg embedded subgroup 18. monitor subgroup means, whose scale 1.5/51.5/\sqrt{5}, first twelve subgroups serving Phase . detector stopped seventh Phase II subgroup (subgroup 19) observations consumed, warning reports. estimate change point sixth Phase II subgroup, subgroup 18, shift embedded.  edetect_report() lists assumed, detector built happened; tidy() returns trajectory, one row per observation.
code: tablets <- aggregate(weight ~ subgroup, shewhartr::tablet_weight, mean) head(tablets, 3) #>   subgroup   weight #> 1        1 250.6670 #> 2        2 250.0480 #> 3        3 250.2758  design <- edetect_design(arl = 370, class = "subgaussian", center = 250,                          sigma = 1.5 / sqrt(5), direction = "both") design #>  #> ── e-detector design ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> Pre-change class: "subgaussian"; centre 250 (declared) #> Sub-Gaussian scale: 0.6708 #> Direction: "both"; type: "sr"; target ARL 370 (threshold 370 on the e-detector #> scale) #> Mixture over 12 shifts: 0.168, 0.335, 0.671, 1.01, 1.34, 2.01, -0.168, -0.335, #> -0.671, -1.01, -1.34, -2.01 chart <- edetect_update(edetect_init(design), tablets$weight[13:25]) #> Warning: Alarm at t = 7; 6 later observations were not consumed. chart #>  #> ── e-detector chart ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> "subgaussian" class, centre 250 (declared), direction "both", type "sr", target #> ARL 370 #> ✖ Alarm at t = 7 (evidence 8510 >= 370); estimated change at t = 6. edetect_alarm(chart) #> # A tibble: 1 × 6 #>   alarm alarm_time evidence threshold change_estimate n_observed #>   <lgl>      <int>    <dbl>     <dbl>           <int>      <int> #> 1 TRUE           7    8509.       370               6          7 autoplot(chart) edetect_report(chart) #>  #> ── e-detector report ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── #> Class "subgaussian", centre 250 (declared); direction "both"; type "sr"; target #> ARL 370. #> Observations: 7. Maximum evidence 8510 against a threshold of 370. #> ✖ Alarm at t = 7 (evidence 8510); estimated change at t = 6. #>  #> ── Assumptions ── #>  #> • Pre-change observations have mean equal to 250 and sub-Gaussian tails with #> scale 0.6708. #> • The centre was declared by the user. #> • Observations arrive in time order and none was dropped or imputed. #> • Under these assumptions the expected time to a false alarm is at least 370, #> and the probability of a false alarm by any time t is at most t/370. #> edetect 0.1.0, R version 4.6.1 (2026-06-24) tidy(chart) #> # A tibble: 7 × 9 #>       t     x     n log_evalue evidence evidence_cusum threshold change_estimate #>   <int> <dbl> <dbl>      <dbl>    <dbl>          <dbl>     <dbl>           <int> #> 1     1  250.     1     -0.543    0.581          0.581       370               1 #> 2     2  250.     1     -0.684    0.884          0.538       370               2 #> 3     3  250.     1     -0.702    1.19           0.503       370               2 #> 4     4  251.     1     -0.444    1.79           0.648       370               4 #> 5     5  249.     1      0.663    3.31           1.97        370               5 #> 6     6  252.     1      4.51    94.4           91.2         370               6 #> 7     7  252.     1      2.94  8509.          8453.          370               6 #> # ℹ 1 more variable: alarm <lgl>

code: design <- edetect_design(arl = 100, class = "subgaussian", center = 0, sigma = 1, direction = "up") set.seed(1) no_change <- edetect_arl(design, pre = function(n) rnorm(n), n_rep = 100, max_t = 3000) no_change$summary #> # A tibble: 1 × 6 #>   arl_estimate    se censored target_arl n_rep max_t #>          <dbl> <dbl>    <dbl>      <dbl> <int> <int> #> 1         190.  17.1        0        100   100  3000 design_b <- edetect_design(arl = 100, class = "bounded", center = 0.5, bounds = c(0, 1), direction = "up") set.seed(2) generators <- list(   uniform = function(n) runif(n),   beta = function(n) rbeta(n, 4, 4),   two_point = function(n) rbinom(n, 1, 0.5)) sapply(generators, function(g) edetect_arl(design_b, pre = g, n_rep = 60, max_t = 3000)$summary$arl_estimate) #>   uniform      beta two_point  #> 107.26667  99.83333 109.90000

title: Run lengths and detection delays
text: bounded data two e-value families available. betting e-value 1 + lambda (x - centre) tight data concentrated inside bounds; sub-Bernoulli exponential e-value Hoeffding bound slower unless data sit bounds.
code: set.seed(6) families <- sapply(c("betting", "hoeffding"), function(ev) {   d <- edetect_design(arl = 100, class = "bounded", center = 0.5, bounds = c(0, 1), direction = "up", evalue = ev)   edetect_arl(d, pre = function(n) runif(n, 0.3, 0.7), post = function(n) runif(n, 0.45, 0.85),               change_at = 50, n_rep = 60, max_t = 800)$summary$delay_mean }) round(families, 1) #>   betting hoeffding  #>       7.6      34.6

title: Anytime-Valid Control Charts with E-Detectors
text: Anytime-valid control charts e-detectors. edetect answers one question: monitor process change raise alarm guaranteed false-alarm rate, without assuming parametric model process change? implements e-detectors (Shin, Ramdas & Rinaldo, 2024): nonparametric, anytime-valid analogues CUSUM Shiryaev–Roberts charts, built e-values bounded, sub-Gaussian, Bernoulli Poisson observations, guaranteed average run length (ARL) false alarm every distribution declared pre-change class. package follows Phase / Phase II workflow shewhartr result-contract conventions seqbench: every alarm (absence) comes assumed, detector built observed.

title: Pre-change classes — edetect_classes
text: "bounded": observations known bounds [, b] mean (direction ""), least ("") equal ("") center. Nothing else assumed. E-values: "betting" (tight, default) "hoeffding" (sub-Bernoulli). "subgaussian": observations mean center sub-Gaussian tails declared scale sigma. Gaussian data standard deviation sigma boundary case; heavier tails violate class. "bernoulli": counts successes subgroups size n, trial conditional success probability (given earlier trials subgroup) /least/equal center; beyond , dependence within subgroup allowed. p chart. "poisson": counts exposure n whose moment generating function Poisson rate center per unit exposure (Poisson underdispersed counts; overdispersed counts violate class). c (n = 1) u charts.

title: Design an e-detector — edetect_design
text: arl Target average run length false alarm. alarm threshold arl e-detector scale (equivalently alpha = 1 / arl). class Pre-change class, see edetect_classes(). center Pre-change mean ("bounded", "subgaussian"), success probability ("bernoulli") rate per unit exposure ("poisson"). May omitted phase1 supplied. bounds Known bounds c(, b) observations ("bounded" ). sigma Declared sub-Gaussian scale ("subgaussian" ). May omitted phase1 supplied, case Phase standard deviation used recorded assumption. direction Change detect: increase (""), decrease ("") either ("", half--half mixture two). type "sr" (Shiryaev–Roberts type, sum e-processes started every time) "cusum" (CUSUM type, maximum). e-detectors use threshold arl, CUSUM type valid conservative (Shin, Ramdas Rinaldo, 2024, Section 2.5); "sr" default. evalue E-value family "bounded" class: "betting" (1 + lambda (x - center), tight bounded data) "hoeffding" (sub-Bernoulli exponential). Ignored classes, use natural exponential e-values. delta Post-change shifts mixture covers, units observations (positive numbers; sign follows direction). shift mapped bet lambda optimal class. default geometric grid spanning small large shifts. weights Mixture weights delta, normalised internally. Default uniform. phase1 Optional Phase (-control) data: numeric vector "bounded" "subgaussian" classes, data frame columns x (counts) n "bernoulli" "poisson". Used set center (sigma) declared; source recorded design every report.

title: edetect 0.1.0
text: First CRAN release. E-detector engine: edetect_design() (pre-change classes bounded, subgaussian, bernoulli, poisson; directions , , ; Shiryaev-Roberts CUSUM types; mixture post-change shifts mapped optimal bet class; optional Phase estimation centre scale, recorded assumption), edetect_init(), edetect_update(), edetect_restart(), edetect_alarm(), edetect_report(). Charts: edetect_x(), edetect_p(), edetect_c(), edetect_u(), edetect_regression(). S3 class edetect_chart print, summary, tidy, glance, autoplot. edetect_arl(): Monte Carlo run lengths (ARL without change, delay false alarms change), vectorised across replications. Getting-started vignette.
